name: brojev
description: Fast browser agent for Claude Code: a Jev-driven run tool that completes browser sub-tasks in seconds, plus full Playwright-level primitives (snapshot, click, type, iframes, shadow DOM, dialogs, uploads, drag, tabs, emulation) on a dedicated Chrome profile. No Playwright, no extension.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Used by the run tool (Jev). Create one at https://console.typesafe.ai/keys. Leave empty to use only the primitive tools or to keep the key in ~/.brojev/env.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key (optional)
openrouter_api_key.description: Optional helper model that writes form text you did not pass in values. Leave empty to skip.
